edits.new: Select each direction's reported case after checking candidate admission and exclusion, rather than committing to the first candidate. If an initial candidate is inadmissible, covered or materially ambiguous, test independent candidates against other applicable parent conditions before deciding the direction. Record one open-ended question per direction, naming both nodes and reporting the decisive case, or the remaining unresolved case when that direction remains unresolved.
